name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.8.1: restore the ability to rename a machine. The edit-machine form was reachable from an edit pill in the old machines table; the v5.97 find-and-tap redesign replaced that table with card rows and orphaned the entry point, so openEditMachine was defined but callable from nowhere and machine name, location and operator name could not be changed from the UI. An edit button now sits in the machine-detail header, and saving refreshes the detail view so the new name appears immediately rather than after navigating away. The backend PUT already accepted these fields; no API change. Cumulative over v6.8.
